title: Preflight the two raw source folders

commands.result: PASS — 134 tickets, 240 anchors resolve, acyclic DAG

acceptanceResults.criterion: Both unmodified uploads are recognized and hashed without modification.
acceptanceResults.evidence: Folder scans reproduce the pinned baseline tree digests exactly for both repositories (483 and 7303 entries). Inputs are chmod a-w on the host and bind-mounted :ro into the container; a repeat scan yields an identical digest.

acceptanceResults.criterion: New downloads with changed content produce an explicit drift report and block automatic baseline substitution.
acceptanceResults.evidence: compareInventory returns missing/extra/changed/caseCollisions and retains the BASELINE value alongside the observed one, so nothing is overwritten by what was found on disk. CLI exits 2 on DRIFT_REQUIRES_REVIEW. Demonstrated live: the Windows-extracted symlink was reported as drift rather than absorbed.

acceptanceResults.criterion: No Git clone, npm install, hook execution, or remote write occurs during inspection.
acceptanceResults.evidence: Structurally enforced and asserted by test: the preflight modules import only node:crypto, node:fs, node:path and node:zlib. A regression introducing child_process, node:http/https/net, fetch, execSync or spawnSync fails the suite.

requirementResults.requirement: Resolve supplied roots by package/schema sentinels, not only folder names; reject a root nested inside the destination.
requirementResults.note: Sentinel-based resolution verified against renamed, spaced, Unicode and Windows-separator paths, a download wrapper directory, a missing sentinel and an ambiguous two-candidate input. Destination nesting is rejected in both directions; the in-place layout is permitted only via the explicitly declared quarantine recorded in docs/designs/in-place-source-quarantine.md.

requirementResults.requirement: Calculate raw-byte SHA-256 inventories, detect symlinks and case collisions, and compare with the supplied baseline.
requirementResults.note: Symlinks are hashed by target string and never followed; a file substituted for a symlink is reported as a kind change. Case collisions are reported even on a case-sensitive filesystem.

requirementResults.requirement: Preserve ZIP comment revision strings as unverified archive metadata; require independent verification before marking an upstream commit verified.
requirementResults.note: The EOCD comment is surfaced as archiveCommentRevisionCandidate. upstream-lock.json types independentlyVerifiedCommit as null and gitHistoryIncluded as false, so this tool cannot promote a candidate to a verified commit.

findings.summary: Windows extraction destroyed the single upstream symlink.
findings.detail: Extracting hyperframes-main.zip with Windows unzip materialised packages/producer/tests/render-symlinked-assets/src/shared as a real directory containing brand.css. Preflight reported 1 missing + 1 extra rather than passing. Re-extracted inside the Linux container, where the Docker Desktop bind mount preserves the link; the tree digest then matched the baseline.
findings.consequence: All source extraction must happen inside the container. Recorded so a future re-extract on the host does not silently reintroduce it.

findings.summary: Ticket requirement conflicts with the chosen in-place build layout.
findings.detail: AFM-001 requires rejecting a source root nested inside the destination; _sources/ lives inside the output repository by design. Resolved with a narrow declared quarantine exemption rather than removing the check, per docs/EXECUTION_RULES.md's requirement that conflicts produce an explicit architecture decision.
findings.consequence: Exempted inputs appear in quarantinedInputs in every report, so an in-place build is always visible in the provenance trail.

notPerformed: Independent verification of the archive comment revision candidates against upstream Git history. The inputs carry no history and no remote access was authorized; both remain candidates.
Application build, package import or render. Those belong to later tickets.
